mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_file (board_id, orig_name, saved_name, file_path, file_type, file_size) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{origName}, #{savedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize})
mapper.select: SELECT board_file_id AS boardFileId, board_id AS boardId, orig_name AS origName, saved_name AS savedName, file_path AS filePath, file_type AS fileType, file_size AS fileSize, reg_date AS regDate FROM board_file WHERE board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY board_file_id ASC
